category_title: Underachieving students in difficult PE contexts who alternate between task involvement and ephemeral off-task behaviors
scenario_title: Managing peer provocation and safety risks during group work
minimal_context: Students are working in small groups practicing somersaults on mats during a gymnastics workshop in PE class.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: Please get into your groups of three to five and practice performing somersaults on the mats.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: (Exercises briefly, then suddenly leaves the task to go talk to another student in a nearby group) If the teacher wasn't there, we'd just have fun all day.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: Let's get back to your own mat and keep practicing.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: (Regularly checks the teacher's location in the classroom to be discreet) It's cool; we're winding each other up with my mates, making jokes (laughs).

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: Make sure you are taking turns doing the somersaults.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: (Pushes another student during a somersault to make them fall) Yeah, here I'm having a bit of fun with my mate ...(laughs), he's going for a roll and boom ...I push him. He fell over ...We have a laugh together, he did it to me earlier ...We're just having fun ...

task.content: Performing somersaults on mats in a group setting

context.environment: Gymnastics workshops in a secondary school PE class
context.materials: Safety equipment (mats) and mini-trampoline for jumping
context.social_setting: Students should work in groups of three to five people

challenging_behavior_trigger.condition: Having fun provoking their peers by playing them nasty tricks
challenging_behavior_trigger.observable_behavior: Push another student during a somersault to make them fall, so they can have a laugh with their friends
related_quotes: Yeah, here I'm having a bit of fun with my mate ...(laughs), he's going for a roll and boom ...I push him. He fell over ...We have a laugh together, he did it to me earlier ...We're just having fun ...

behavior_patterns.observable_behavior: Take the mat off while another was jumping
behavior_patterns.internal_state: Found it funny to take the mat off
related_quotes: If the teacher wasn't there, we'd just have fun all day. It's cool; we're winding each other up with my mates, making jokes (laughs). [ ...] we've got to be sly not to get caught by the teacher.

behavior_patterns.condition: In no time, a game between two students attracts other students
behavior_patterns.observable_behavior: Deliberately take part in the game or start their own with other students. These deviances increase until they provoke the withdrawal from one or several activities.
behavior_patterns.internal_state: Learnt how to hide their games from the teacher – by regularly checking the teacher's location in the classroom, being discreet not to be caught
